s05801E.name: Level load: init buffers, background, start screens
summary: Three routines. $05801E (JSL from game mode level load): fills the layer 2 background buffer $7EB900-$7EC0FF, decompresses a
prebuilt background if the layer 2 bank byte [$6A] is $FF, clears the Map16 buffers ($7EC800 = $25, $7FC800 = 0), runs LoadLevel
and (game mode < $22) calls CODE_02A751.
$05809E: draws the first 32 columns/rows of layers 1 and 2 around the scroll position (calling the column builders and the VRAM DMA),
cycles the pointers of Map16 tiles $133-$13A, and sets TM/TS and window masks from [$0D9D]/[$0D9E].
$058126: decompresses RLE data at [$68] to $7E:B900 (control byte: bit 7 = repeat next byte, low 7 bits = count - 1; $FFFF ends).

s0581BB.name: Table: Map16 tile data source bitmask
summary: 512 bits, one per Map16 tile ($000-$1FF), MSB first. Bit set: the tile's 8-byte data comes from the shared set at $05:8000;
clear: from the tileset-specific block. Read by CODE_0581FB.

s0581FB.name: Map16 tile pointers; level buffer fill routines
summary: $0581FB: builds the 512-entry Map16 tile data pointer table at $0FBE using the bitmask above, tileset [$1931],
and sets [$1430]/[$1431] (probably the sprite-touchable tile range). For tilesets 0 and 7 it also disables that range and points tiles
$1C4-$1C7 and $1EC-$1EF at $8A70+.
$0582C8: stores A at X in each 512-byte page of $7EC800-$7EFFFF, then X++. $05833A: the same for $7FC800-$7FFFFF.
Parameters: A = value, X = offset within each page. Returns: X incremented.

LoadLevel.name: Load level header and tileset
summary: Layer number [$1933] = 0, parses the level header at [$65] (CODE_0584E3) and sets up the tileset's Map16 pointers (CODE_0581FB).

LoadAgain.name: Load objects of one layer
summary: Boss modes $09, $0B and $10 have no object data. Otherwise, if the layer's data does not start with $FF, loads its objects with LoadLevelData.
Reused for layer 2 (second pass with [$65] = [$68] + 5).

LevLoadNotEmpty.name: Switch to layer 2 objects or finish
summary: Modes $00, $0A, $0C, $0D, $0E, $11 and $1E have no layer 2 objects. Otherwise bumps the layer number [$1933], points [$65]-[$67] at the
layer 2 object stream ([$68]-[$6A] + 5, past its header), clears [$1928] and loops back to LoadAgain. Finishes after layer 2.

LoadLevelDone.name: Finish level load
summary: Resets the layer number [$1933] to 0 and returns.

VerticalTable.name: Table: level mode vertical flags
summary: Indexed by level mode ($1925). Bit 0 = layer 1 is vertical, bit 1 = layer 2 is vertical; stored in [$5B]. Bit 7 is set for some modes (meaning unclear).

LevMainScrnTbl.name: Table: level mode main screen layers
summary: TM value per level mode: bit 0 BG1, bit 1 BG2, bit 2 BG3, bit 4 OBJ. Stored in [$0D9D].

LevSubScrnTbl.name: Table: level mode subscreen layers
summary: TS value per level mode. Stored in [$0D9E].

LevCGADSUBtable.name: Table: level mode color math settings
summary: CGADSUB value per level mode. Stored in [$40].

SpecialLevTable.name: Table: level mode boss room type
summary: Stored in [$0D9B]: $00 normal, $80 Iggy/Larry room, $C0 Morton/Ludwig/Roy room, $C1 Bowser. Bit 7 switches NMI/IRQ to the Mode 7 path.

LevXYPPCCCTtbl.name: Table: level mode sprite OAM property mask
summary: Stored in [$64]; XORed into most sprites' YXPPCCCT bytes (level modes using $20 vs $30).

TimerTable.name: Table: level timer hundreds digit
summary: Indexed by header byte 4 bits 6-7: 0 = no timer, 2, 3 or 4 hundred seconds.

LevelMusicTable.name: Music table; level header parse (bytes 1-2)
summary: $0584DB: music track number for the 3-bit music field of the header.
$0584E3: parses the level header at [$65]. Byte 1: bits 0-4 screens - 1 ([$5D]), bits 5-7 BG palette ([$1930]).
Byte 2: bits 0-4 level mode ([$1925]), which indexes the mode tables for OAM mask, TM, TS, color math, boss type and vertical flags; bits 5-7 BG color ([$192F]).
Sets [$5E]/[$5F] (horizontal/vertical screen counts) from the screen count and vertical flag.

LevelModeEven.name: Level header parse (bytes 2-5): music, timer, tileset
summary: Byte 3: sprite GFX set ([$192B]), music (into [$0DDA] with flags for 'same as before'), layer 3 priority (BGMODE mirror [$3E]).
Byte 4: timer (only if [$141A] = 0), FG palette ([$192D]), sprite palette ([$192E]).
Byte 5: tileset ([$1931]/[$1932]), item memory ([$13BE]), scroll mode ([$1412]; 3 also clears [$1411]).

HeaderVHscroll.name: Header scroll setting; swap object X/Y nibbles
summary: $0585C7: stores the scroll mode and advances [$65]-[$67] by 5 so it points at the object data. Returns.
$0585D8: for vertical layers, swaps the low nibbles of object bytes [$0A] and [$0B] (X and Y positions), except for screen exit/jump
extended objects ([$5A] = 0 and [$59] < 2).

LoadLevelData.name: Load one level object and find its Map16 address
summary: Reads a 3-byte object at [$65] into [$0A], [$0B], [$59] and advances [$65]. Object number [$5A] = [$0B] >> 4 | ([$0A] & $60) >> 1;
[$57] = YX position within the screen. Handles the new-screen flag ([$0A] bit 7 increments [$1928]), looks up the screen's Map16 low and
high byte buffer addresses via LoadBlkPtrs/LoadBlkTable2 into [$6B]-[$6D] and [$6E]-[$70] (+$100 if [$0A] bit 4 is set), then dispatches to the
extended or standard object loader.

LoadNoHiCoord.name: Dispatch to extended or standard object
summary: Object number 0 means an extended object (CODE_0DA100); otherwise the standard object loader runs.

LevLoadJsrNrm.name: Call standard object loader
summary: Calls LevLoadNrmObj ($05:86EA).

LevLoadContinue.name: Loop to next object
summary: If the next byte at [$65] is not $FF, loads the next object, otherwise returns.

LevLoadExtObj.name: Load extended object
summary: Calls CODE_0DA100 in bank $0D to load an extended object.
